annotations.title: Query Golf EV, Strokes Gained & Course Strategy

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Read-only, idempotent query of 157,480-point golf EV, Strokes Gained, dispersion, and GPS strategy across 2,005 courses in 47 prefectures (API key or x402; 24h). Pass mode with distance/lie or courseId (default mode="ev", limit=10, offset=0); returns shot metrics ordered by query index. Note: For POIs, use query_seismic_hazards instead.

coreScore.description: Player benchmark score (64 to 125). Overrides skillLevel if specified.

currentDistanceYards.description: [Mode "strategy"] Optional current distance to the hole in yards (1 to 700) to compute required advance yardage.

distance.description: [Mode "ev" | "dispersion"] Remaining distance to the pin (0 to 700, e.g. 150).

drivingDistance.description: Player average driver distance in yards (rounded to nearest 10-yard band between 180 and 330).

end.description: [Mode "sg"] Ending ball state after the shot (use lie="hole_out" or distance=0 when holed).

distance.description: Ending distance to the hole (0 to 700).

lie.description: Ending ball lie after the shot (or "hole_out").

facilityName.description: [Mode "course_search" | "hole_strategy"] Golf facility name filter (e.g. "ヒバリゴルフクラブ").

holeNumber.description: [Mode "hole_strategy"] Specific hole number (1-18). Omit to compute the full GamePlan for all holes in the course.

includeHoles.description: [Mode "course_search"] Include hole-by-hole GPS coordinates and yardages.

isObRetee.description: [Mode "sg"] True if the shot went Out-of-Bounds (OB) requiring a re-tee (SG = -2.0).

mode.description: Calculation mode: "ev" (Shot/Putt Expected Value & lie penalties), "sg" (Strokes Gained between start and end states), "dispersion" (ShotCircle landing dispersion ellipse & 8-level benchmarks), "strategy" (Target EV reverse distance lookup), "course_search" (Search 2,005 Japanese golf facilities / 4,647 courses / 41,812 valid holes [raw 41,825 rows; 13 anomalous rows quarantined] GPS data), or "hole_strategy" (Hole-by-hole GPS GamePlan, SG=0 landing coordinates & tee/approach dispersion for a real course).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (0..10000, default 0). Combine with limit to page through result sets deterministically.

penalty.description: [Mode "sg"] Penalty strokes incurred on the shot (0 to 10, default 0).

queries.description: Optional batch of 1 to 10 shot/strategy queries in a single request.

items.description: Individual ANSR golf calculation query object.

query.description: [Mode "course_search" | "hole_strategy"] Golf facility name, kana, or English substring (e.g. "ヒバリゴルフクラブ", "Hibari", "ゴールド札幌").

skillLevel.description: Optional preset skill level name or code: "World Ranker" (W↑: 68/300y), "National Ranker" (G↑: 70/270y), "Professional" (N↑: 72/270y), "Scratch" (0-: 75/250y), "Under 5" (5↓: 78/250y), "Single" (S↓: 81/230y), "80s" (8↓: 89/200y), "90s" (9↓: 98/200y).

start.description: [Mode "sg"] Starting ball state before the shot (distance, unit, and lie).

distance.description: Starting distance to the hole (0 to 700).

lie.description: Starting ball lie before the shot.

state.description: [Mode "course_search"] Nationwide prefecture filter across all 47 Japanese prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "兵庫県", "沖縄県").

targetEV.description: [Mode "strategy"] Target Expected Value (strokes to hole out, 1.0 to 10.0, default 3.0) to reverse-solve for required remaining fairway distance.

name: query_golf_strategy

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this response payload was generated.

items.description: Deterministic 157,480-point golf Expected Value, Strokes Gained, ShotCircle dispersion, and 2,005-course GPS GamePlan items ordered by query index.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset applied to the matched record slice.

partialResult.description: True only if a live upstream sub-source returned partial coverage.

returnedCount.description: Number of structured records returned in items for this page.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the dataset.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 provenance digest of the returned items.

stats.description: Execution telemetry including itemCount, durationMs, and upstream breakdown.

streamId.description: Underlying B2A data stream identifier that fulfilled the query.

success.description: True when the read-only query completed without upstream or validation failure.

toolName.description: Executed MCP tool name for deterministic audit correlation.
